summary: DTI filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that its wholly owned subsidiary engaged a Norwegian investment bank to arrange Nordic fixed-income investor meetings beginning October 14, 2026 ahead of a contemplated USD-denominated senior secured bond. Net proceeds are earmarked to partially fund the previously announced acquisition of Saltire Energy Limited, repay the existing term loan fully and part of the ABL revolver, plus general corporate purposes. Bonds would be sold under Rule 144A/Regulation S. No price, size, premium, board recommendation or advisor is specified; the offering remains subject to market conditions.
